translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Ebu Leheb´in iki eline yuh oldu, kendine de yuh
translations.diyanet-isleri: Ebu Leheb'in elleri kurusun; kurudu da
translations.clear-quran: May the hands of Abu Lahab perish, and he ˹himself˺ perish
translations.pickthall: The power of Abu Lahab will perish, and he will perish

segments.content: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Ona ne malı fayda verdi, ne de kazandığı
translations.diyanet-isleri: Malı ve kazandığı kendisine fayda vermedi
translations.clear-quran: Neither his wealth nor ˹worldly˺ gains will benefit him
translations.pickthall: His wealth and gains will not exempt him

translations.clear-quran: He will burn in a flaming Fire
translations.pickthall: He will be plunged in flaming Fire

translations.diyanet-isleri: Karısı da, boynunda bir ip olduğu halde ona odun taşıyacaktır
translations.clear-quran: and ˹so will˺ his wife, the carrier of ˹thorny˺ kindling

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Gerdanında fitillisinden bir ip olduğu halde
translations.diyanet-isleri: Karısı da, boynunda bir ip olduğu halde ona odun taşıyacaktır
translations.clear-quran: around her neck will be a rope of palm-fibre
translations.pickthall: Will have upon her neck a halter of palm-fibre
